## 5. Recommendations

#### Pre-Transfer Optimization
```
□ Endometrial receptivity confirmation
  └─ Document trilaminar pattern via ultrasound
  └─ Consider ERA test if receptivity concern

□ Luteal phase support
  └─ Progesterone vaginal/IM (400-600mg or 50mg IM)
  └─ Continue minimum 10 weeks if positive β-hCG

□ Trigger protocol review
  └─ Assess if dual trigger would improve maturation rate 
     in future cycles

□ Pre-transfer day coordination
  └─ Confirm Day 5 timing with P4 monitoring
```

#### Lifestyle Interventions (Before/During Transfer)

MODERATE ► Stress reduction — mindfulness, acupuncture evidence-based

           (risk of micronutrient deficiency)
```

```

3. HYSTEROSCOPY

4. PREIMPLANTATION GENETIC TESTING (PGT-A)

   └─ Particularly if recurrent failure pattern emerges

5. THROMBOPHILIA & IMMUNOLOGICAL PANEL
